cases.name: Portal order + native retry commits once, notifies primary Sales and HN only, no stock changes
Other Sales and wrong-role warehouse cannot read/quote the owned customer order
HCM routing is isolated from HN
Admin handover changes new ownership/permissions while historical order Sales snapshots stay immutable
Retry leaves no duplicate recipient events; all waiting-quote orders leave stock untouched
Quote revision has immutable versions, resets reviews, and customer acceptance still blocks fulfillment when stock is missing
Actual late stock receipt is detected by the worker readiness service once; scoped SQL stage filters match the evaluator
Dashboard metrics apply Sales/date scope and never count accepted but unshipped orders as revenue
Durable text notices retry with a fake provider; email failure leaves orders/in-app notices intact and overlapping recipient rules deduplicate
Concurrent event replay, personal-only overlap and replaced rules cannot send a second email for the same order/customer identity
